# Licensing — Wyatt's Notes

> Free, open-access study notes. Part of the Wyatt's Notes network at https://wyattsnotes.wyattau.com

Practical software licensing guidance: choosing between MIT, GPL, Apache, and other licenses; understanding copyleft vs permissive models; handling license

All pages are open-access, ad-free, and licensed under AGPLv3.
